inauthentic_content_policy.key_rule: Automation without quality control is penalized. Automation WITH quality control is fine.

red_flags.description: Every video uses identical structure, visuals, and pacing
red_flags.mitigation: Vary script templates, visual styles, and pacing across videos

red_flags.description: AI voice reads text without editorial personality or unique perspective
red_flags.mitigation: Add editorial voice, opinions, and unique analysis to scripts

red_flags.description: Same B-roll, same transitions, same graphics every video
red_flags.mitigation: Source unique B-roll per topic, vary visual approaches

red_flags.description: Surface-level coverage without deep research or original insight
red_flags.mitigation: Conduct deep research with 5+ sources per topic, add original analysis

red_flags.description: Static images with basic TTS narration, no storytelling
red_flags.mitigation: Use dynamic visuals, motion graphics, and narrative structure

red_flags.flag: Readings of content creator did not originally create
red_flags.description: TTS reads Wikipedia or other sources without transformation
red_flags.mitigation: Transform source material into original narrative with unique perspective

red_flags.description: Same story structure applied to every topic without variation
red_flags.mitigation: Vary story structures: investigative, explanatory, narrative, comparative

red_flags.flag: No evidence of human editorial judgment
red_flags.description: Content appears to be auto-generated without human oversight
red_flags.mitigation: Add human review step, editorial commentary, unique framing

channel_level: Videos generating largest share of watch time
what_they_look_for: Content that is original and adds value
what_is_safe: Stock footage with original narration and analysis
Consistent publishing schedule (not a red flag)

our_mitigation: Unique research per video with 5+ sources
Original editorial perspective in every script

items.check: SFX and music selected from licensed sources
LUFS at -13 to -14, true peak -1 dBTP
Ken Burns on all still images
Title: under 60 chars, keyword in first 5 words

deep_research.requirement: Each video must have unique research with multiple sources
deep_research.check: Verify research files exist for this topic

original_analysis.requirement: Scripts must include original perspective, not just read sources
original_analysis.check: Verify script contains editorial voice and unique framing

unique_visuals.requirement: B-roll and visuals should be topic-specific, not generic
unique_visuals.check: Verify visual assets are unique to this video

consistent_branding.requirement: Channel has consistent visual identity across all videos
consistent_branding.check: Verify branding spec exists and is followed

varied_approaches.requirement: Videos should vary in structure and approach
varied_approaches.check: Verify not using identical template for every video

monitoring: Check YouTube Studio for any policy flags weekly
Monitor monetization status on all videos
Review audience retention curves for quality signals
Track subscriber growth vs. content quality
Watch for automated AI labels from YouTube

if_flagged: Strengthen editorial ownership in future content
Appeal if content is genuinely original
